reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Soniox

stt.title: Speech-to-text
stt.description: These settings apply to Assist speech-to-text. API key and region are under **Reconfigure**. If a list is empty, enable **Model listing** in the [Soniox console]({console_url}) or type the model id.

data_description.language_hints: Expected languages in addition to the Assist pipeline language.
data_description.context: Background text that helps names and domain terms.
data_description.enable_endpoint_detection: Detect when the speaker has finished.
data_description.enable_translation: Translate the transcript into one target language.
data_description.translation_target: Used only when one-way translation is enabled.

tts.title: Text-to-speech
tts.description: Shared voices come from the API. Cloned voices need the **Cloned voices** permission. If the list is missing, enable **Model listing** in the [Soniox console]({console_url}) or type a voice name such as Adrian.

data_description.tts_voice: Shared voice name or a cloned voice id.
data_description.reduce_silence: Shorten pauses between words when the model supports it.

quota_exhausted.title: Soniox quota exhausted
quota_exhausted.description: Soniox rejected the request because the project balance or monthly budget is exhausted (error_type: {error_type}, request_id: {request_id}). Add credit or raise the budget in the Soniox console, then reload the integration.

permission_denied.title: Soniox API key is missing a permission
permission_denied.description: The Soniox API key is valid but is not allowed to use this endpoint (error_type: {error_type}, request_id: {request_id}). Grant the key the required permission in the Soniox console, then reload the integration.

python_realtime_regression.title: Python {python_version} breaks Soniox realtime streams
python_realtime_regression.description: An ssl regression in this Python version (CPython/gh-137583) makes the Soniox realtime speech-to-text and text-to-speech WebSocket connections hang without an error. Update Home Assistant Core to a version that does not ship Python {python_version}.
